title: Yellowstone: The World’s First National Park
titleZh: 黄石：世界上第一个国家公园

sentences.en: Yellowstone National Park in the western United States was the world’s first national park.
sentences.zh: 美国西部的黄石国家公园是世界上第一个国家公园。

sentences.en: Established in 1872, it is famous for its geothermal activity and wild animals.
sentences.zh: 它建于1872年，以地热活动和野生动物而闻名。

sentences.en: It includes beautiful mountains, deep canyons, lakes and rivers.
sentences.zh: 这里包括壮丽的山脉、深邃的峡谷、湖泊和河流。

sentences.en: Yellowstone is still one of the largest national parks in the U.S. It takes up almost 9,000 square kilometers.
sentences.zh: 黄石至今仍是美国最大的国家公园之一，占地面积近9000平方公里。

sentences.en: Most of the park lies within the western state of Wyoming.
sentences.zh: 公园的大部分位于西部的怀俄明州境内。

sentences.en: The park is unusual because of what lies underneath it.
sentences.zh: 这座公园与众不同，原因在于其地下蕴藏的东西。

sentences.en: It sits on top of an ancient super volcano, known as the Yellowstone Caldera.
sentences.zh: 它坐落于一个古老的超级火山之上，即黄石破火山口。

sentences.en: The caldera remains an active volcano.
sentences.zh: 这座破火山口至今仍是活跃的火山。

sentences.en: A lake of hot liquid rock is about six kilometers under the park.
sentences.zh: 在公园地下约六公里处，有一湖炽热的液态岩石。

sentences.en: Experts say this lake is under huge amounts of pressure.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，这湖岩浆承受着巨大的压力。

sentences.en: The pressure and heat cause geysers to shoot hot water out of the ground and mud to boil at Yellowstone.
sentences.zh: 这种压力和高温使间歇泉将热水喷涌出地面，并使泥浆在黄石沸腾。

sentences.en: The park is home to more than 300 geysers.
sentences.zh: 这座公园拥有300多座间歇泉。

sentences.en: There are more geysers and hot springs in Yellowstone than any other place on Earth.
sentences.zh: 黄石国家公园的间歇泉和温泉比地球上任何其他地方都要多。

sentences.en: “Old Faithful” is the name of the park’s most famous geyser because it erupts about every 90 minutes.
sentences.zh: “老忠实泉”是这座公园最著名的间歇泉的名字，因为它大约每90分钟喷发一次。

sentences.en: Yellowstone is on a high plateau with an average height of 2,400 meters above sea level.
sentences.zh: 黄石位于一个高高原之上，平均海拔2400米。

sentences.en: This makes the weather very cold in winter, with January temperatures averaging between -18 degrees and -7 degrees Celsius.
sentences.zh: 这使得这里的冬季非常寒冷，一月的平均气温在零下18度到零下7度之间。

sentences.en: However, some areas of the park remain open to visitors throughout the year.
sentences.zh: 然而，公园的一些区域全年都对游客开放。

sentences.en: Yellowstone Canyon is about 365 meters deep.
sentences.zh: 黄石大峡谷深约365米。

sentences.en: The Yellowstone River runs through it and drops 93 meters in the Lower Falls.
sentences.zh: 黄石河贯穿其中，在下瀑布处落差达93米。

sentences.en: Visitors can walk on a path that brings them very close to the top of the falls.
sentences.zh: 游客可以沿着一条小径走到离瀑布顶非常近的地方。

sentences.en: There, they can see and hear the powerful falls.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他们可以看到并听到气势磅礴的瀑布。

sentences.en: In summer of 1988, forest fires burned large areas of the park.
sentences.zh: 1988年夏天，森林大火烧毁了公园的大片区域。

sentences.en: Most of those areas are now covered with plants and young trees.
sentences.zh: 如今，这些区域大多已被植物和幼树覆盖。

sentences.en: Yellowstone is home to the largest group of wild animals in the lower 48 United States.
sentences.zh: 黄石是美国本土48个州中野生动物种群最大的地方。

sentences.en: These include bison, grizzly bear, elk, deer, moose, fox, beaver, coyote and wolves.
sentences.zh: 这里生活着野牛、灰熊、马鹿、鹿、驼鹿、狐狸、海狸、郊狼和狼。

sentences.en: In 2024, park officials estimated the bison population to be about 4,500 animals.
sentences.zh: 2024年，公园官员估计野牛种群数量约为4500头。

sentences.en: That makes it the largest group of wild bison in the world.
sentences.zh: 这使它成为世界上最大的野生野牛群。

sentences.en: There is still a wild west in America…and its name is Yellowstone.
sentences.zh: 美国仍有狂野西部的身影……它的名字就是黄石。

sentences.en: I'm Andrew Smith.
sentences.zh: 我是安德鲁·史密斯。

glossary.def: describing geological or volcanic activity that is the result of underground heat
a hot spring that periodically shoots boiling water high into the air as underground steam pressure builds up and is released
an area of land that is flat at the top and higher than surrounding land
